note: What {"help": "<command>"} returns: what the command does, its fields, and examples. Every example is the founder's, from tool-examples.json, in the tool's current words. Do not add an example of your own: an example changes what a model infers.

add.does: Adds an element, or adds fields and wants to an element that exists. The key is the element's address. A list grows; any other field is written. One command names one element.

fields.technical_name: The short practitioner name: the leading words of the address read in reverse.
fields.name: The name this project gives the element.
fields.role: AT, DE, SE, NE, CQU, UD or DD. {"help": "intake/core_concepts"} defines them.
fields.refs: A list with one uri for each artifact that has this address.
fields.status: un_built for functionality that is intended and not built.
fields.wants: A list with one record for each element this element wants. A record holds element (the wanted element's address), why, how and direction (send, receive or both). The wanted element is created at its own address if it is not there.

wants.why: Receive the mash data to relay it.

update.does: Changes fields of an element. A field set to null is removed; a field left out is unchanged. A wants record names its element and gives only the fields to change.

fields.technical_name, name, role, refs, status: As in add. A list replaces the list that is there.
fields.wants: A list of records. Each holds element and the fields to change: why, how or direction.

delete.does: Deletes an element with {}, or removes wants by naming their elements. An element that another element wants is not deleted; the refusal returns the command that removes that want.

orphaned.does: Returns the elements that no element wants, each with its own fields. Being orphaned does not mean an element should be deleted.

goto.does: Places you at an element and returns its fields, its wants, the wants that name it (wanted_by), and the layers that hold records there. A later goto to the same address returns only what changed.

map.does: Returns every address, each want as a pair (the element that holds it, then the wanted element), and the Defining Elements. It returns no fields. The layers are the addresses beneath layer.

addressed read.does: A key that is an address reads that element's own fields. To add a layer to the answer, name it with {} as its value.

raw dump.does: A key that starts with a period returns the stored JSON at that path, with everything beneath it. A period alone returns the whole project.

help.does: {} lists the names help takes. A command name returns what the command does, its fields and examples. intake lists the sections of the intake procedure, and intake/<section> returns one.
